Maybe the goal is to remove ALL green blocks (14 clicks), and the targets will descend to the player's row.
But in the previous runs, the targets jumped after 8 clicks, and the game ended.

Wait, maybe the targets jump when the TOP row of green blocks is removed (7 clicks) AND 1 more click is made (8th click).
In this run, I removed 7 green blocks (the top row) and 2 green blocks (the bottom row), total 9 clicks.
And the targets didn't jump.
So the number of clicks doesn't matter. The position or order of the clicks matters.

1. Top row: cols 19, 25, 31, 37, 43, 49 (6 clicks)
2. Bottom row: cols 13, 19 (2 clicks)

Maybe the targets jump when the top row is NOT completely removed.

So the player position doesn't matter.

Let me try clicking the bottom row first (7 clicks) and then the top row (1 click).
